observedFacts: Teradyne launched advanced UltraFLEXplus instruments engineered for AI and data-center computing devices.
The instruments target larger, higher-power compute devices and advanced packaging roadmaps.
Teradyne introduced Iris 100 for microLED wafer and final test.
The company states the system has a roadmap to support photodetector test capabilities in the same insertion.
Teradyne announced a permanent office in India and an office-opening event on September 15, 2026.
Teradyne stated it would participate in SEMICON India September 17-19, 2026.
The India Semiconductor Mission CEO described the presence in the context of India's scaling fabrication, packaging and test capabilities.
